$comment: Config for the learn-skill meta-skill. 'target' is where new/migrated/updated skills are written, relative to the current project (cwd). 'protectedLocations' are NEVER modified in place; a relevant protected skill is migrated (copied) into 'target' first, then updated. 'allowProtectedWrites' is a deliberate escape hatch. 'features' toggle skill behaviors. 'integrations' opt into rpiv helper extensions — each is only used if BOTH the flag is true AND the package is detected as installed (run `skillctl.ts detect`); otherwise it is skipped silently.
